lifeguard.menu.title: Lifeguard
lifeguard.menu.switch.tooltip:
Left click: next (Auto, On, Off).
Right click: back.

A = Auto, following the profile.
lifeguard.menu.confirm.deep_end.title: Go Off the Deep End?
lifeguard.menu.confirm.deep_end.message: This turns on %s entries, including ones made for Deep End that most players won't want: %s
lifeguard.menu.confirm.dangerous.title: Turn on %s?
lifeguard.menu.confirm.reset.title: Reset overrides?
lifeguard.menu.confirm.reset.message: %s entries switched on or off by hand go back to Auto and follow the profile again. Values like ranges stay as they are.
lifeguard.menu.summary.title: After a restart
lifeguard.menu.summary.subtitle: Your changes are saved. They take effect the next time the game starts.
lifeguard.menu.broken: %s can't be read:, fix it by hand
lifeguard.menu.locked.server: Set by the server you're playing on
lifeguard.menu.locked.broken: %s can't be read, so this can't be changed until it's fixed
lifeguard.menu.details.empty: Click an entry to see what it does
lifeguard.menu.details.why.profile_on: On: the profile includes this taste
lifeguard.menu.details.why.profile_off: Off: the profile doesn't reach this taste
lifeguard.menu.details.planned: Planned: declared ahead of its port, no code yet
lifeguard.menu.details.server_note: The server you're playing on sets this
lifeguard.menu.details.broken_note: Its config file can't be read, so this can't change until it's fixed
lifeguard.taste.none: No taste. A direct extension of someone else's precedent, Lifeguard makes basically no judgement calls.
lifeguard.taste.light: Light taste. Some light calls were needed, but Lifeguard tries to be conservative and follow an existing precedent
lifeguard.taste.strong: Strong/Heavy taste. Lifeguard's own opinionated change.
lifeguard.taste.deep_end: Developed for Deep End. This change was explicitly made to be a part of a specific pack, and probably isn't something most people would want.
lifeguard.taste.dangerous:
Dangerous. Changes to core mechanics with often untested consequences.

ONLY TURN THIS ON IF YOU ARE SURE YOU KNOW WHAT YOU'RE DOING!
lifeguard.taste.none.name: No taste
lifeguard.taste.light.name: Light
lifeguard.taste.strong.name: Strong
lifeguard.taste.deep_end.name: Deep End
lifeguard.taste.dangerous.name: Dangerous
lifeguard.disconnect.registry_shape: This server and your game don't agree on Lifeguard entries that change blocks, so their worlds wouldn't match.
lifeguard.disconnect.registry_shape.serv: On for the server, off for you: %s
lifeguard.disconnect.registry_shape.loca: On for you, off for the server: %s
lifeguard.disconnect.registry_shape.fix: Set them to match in Lifeguard's menu (Server tab), restart the game, and join again.
lifeguard.disconnect.registry_shape.no_l: Your game has Lifeguard entries on that change blocks (%s), and this server doesn't run them (no Lifeguard, or an older one). Turn them off in Lifeguard's menu and restart to play here.
lifeguard.entry.ac_infinite_soda.desc: Makes purple soda infinite exactly like water, where two sources make a third.
lifeguard.entry.ac_infinite_soda.faucets: A Supplementaries faucet on a soda source pours it forever, like water.
lifeguard.entry.am_lava_bottle_dupe.desc: Makes it so lava bottles can no longer go into cauldrons, Supplementaries jars, or goblets, so you can't just farm lava with bottles forever.
With Alex's Mobs' lava bottles turned off, Lava Vision brews from a Potion of Night Vision and a Bone Serpent Tooth instead.
Lets knives slice Amendments' cakes, stacked cakes and cakes eaten from a side, for any cake a mod lets knives slice on its own.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_cauldron_disp: Fixes dispensers no longer pouring potions, dye, milk or stews into an empty cauldron.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_mixed_potion_: Fixes potions mixed in an Amendments cauldron not brewing into splash or lingering potions.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_hanging_pot_n: Makes Jade name an Amendments hanging flower pot after what is actually planted in it, like a standing pot ("Potted Poppy"), instead of always "Hanging Flower Pot".
lifeguard.entry.amendments_lava_drip_lay: Fixes Amendments' consistent_lava_layers config doing nothing for an empty cauldron, where a dripstone drip would still fill it instantly.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_lava_layers.d: Makes it so lava in a cauldron is kept in four layers like every other Moonlight liquid, instead of vanilla's all-or-nothing lava cauldron.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_lava_layers.c: A cauldron of lava still heats Farmer's Delight's cooking pots and skillets, just like vanilla's lava cauldron did.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_lava_layers.f: Makes faucets pour lava into an empty cauldron a layer at a time, again just like any other Moonlight liquid, instead of a whole bucket at once.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_potion_diluti: Fixes an exploit (imo) where mixing potions in an Amendments cauldron being able to copy instant effects into every bottle (for example, one Instant Health potion and three Awkward Potions could make four Instant Health potions). A level II potion counts as two doses of level I, shared out between the bottles, while a a leftover part of a dose just fizzles out, leaving an Awkward Potion if nothing else remains.
A leftover part of a dose of Instant Health becomes as much Regeneration, Harming becomes Poison, instead of fizzling out.
lifeguard.entry.cauldron_fourths.desc: Water and powdered snow cauldrons now hold a bucket as FOUR levels instead of three, with each bottle holding 250mb instead of 333mb, just like every other Moonlight container. This is an extremely invasive change and can break a LOT, so only turn this on if you are prepared for some serious whackamole. Heads up: recipes from other mods that turn a bucket into bottles (or bottles into a bucket) usually still count three, so they no longer match a cauldron.
lifeguard.entry.cauldron_fourths.alexs_c: The Tremorsaurus's stomp ripples water in a cauldron right at its surface at four levels.
lifeguard.entry.cauldron_fourths.amendme: Amendments cauldrons at four levels. Water and powdered snow fill to four, crafting in a cauldron counts four, the dye cauldron holds four, and its cauldron models show all four.
lifeguard.entry.cauldron_fourths.caverns: Golden buckets fill a cauldron to four levels and scoop it only when it's full at four, and a golden milk bucket takes four bottles of milk.
lifeguard.entry.cauldron_fourths.neapoli: Milk and milkshake cauldrons have four levels like the rest, with models for all four, and a milk bucket crafts to and from four bottles.
lifeguard.entry.cauldron_fourths.supplem: Faucets fill water and powdered snow cauldrons to four levels, and a cauldron moved into water fills to four.
Lets you smash C&C's tether, impact and trail potions into Moonlight jars, goblets, and cauldrons, pouring in as a regular, splash or lingering potion. You get the bottle back, but the spinel is gone.
Works on empty cauldrons too, turning them into Amendments potion cauldrons.
lifeguard.entry.citadel_animation_smooth: Fixes keyframed animations from Citadel mods snapping once per tick instead of moving smoothly.
lifeguard.entry.clayworks_flower_pots.de: Dye flower pots any color at Clayworks' pottery table. They keep their color when you plant in them, break them or pick-block them, and now show as a real pot in your inventory.
lifeguard.entry.clayworks_flower_pots.am: Hang a dyed or etched pot with Amendments and it stays that way, and comes back down that way too.
lifeguard.entry.clayworks_flower_pots.de: Etch lil designs onto flower pots at the pottery table with a trim material, just like decorated pots. No sherds though.
lifeguard.entry.clayworks_flower_pots.so: Supplementaries' soap washes a flower pot's color off, keeping its design, same as decorated pots.
lifeguard.entry.moonlight_registration_r: Fixes bugs where Moonlight mods randomly lose things they register while the game starts: generated resources going missing for a whole launch (walls of purple-black goo), a mod's dispenser behaviors vanishing, or a crash on launch.
Makes Jade show what is in Supplementaries' jars and goblets and Amendments' cauldrons by name ("Splash Potion of Swiftness", "Milk", "Red Dye") with how much, where it showed potions, milk or dye as empty and jars and goblets as nothing. Follows Jade's own Fluid Storage settings.
lifeguard.entry.neapolitan_amendments_mi: Allows you to craft neapolitan milkshakes in Amendments liquid cauldrons.
lifeguard.entry.dye_depot_runes.desc: Dye Depot dyes can now be used as Quark runic glint colors. Each glint is styled off of base quark's design.
lifeguard.entry.paper_labels.desc: Use paper on a block to stick a Label label on it, and broken labels give paper back.
lifeguard.entry.quark_amethyst_beacon_ti: Fixes beacon beams going dark when an amethyst cluster redirects them (with Corundum beacon redirection off).
lifeguard.entry.quark_donkey_chests.desc: Fixed issue where quark variant chests stored in donkeys, mules, and llamas would get deleted from existence from it's killed.
lifeguard.entry.quark_elytra_duplication: Fixes Quark's Dragon Scales elytra duplication crashing the game when the elytra and the scale sit on a diagonal in the crafting grid. Quark 4.1 sizes the recipe's leftovers for 2 items instead of for the grid.
lifeguard.entry.quark_parrot_egg_dispens: Fixes dispensers no longer throwing Quark's parrot eggs, following the setting in quark's config.
lifeguard.entry.quark_tool_restock_encha: Fixes a bug causing Quark's Automatic Tool restock to sometimes ignore enchantments, dependent on where there are in your inventory.
lifeguard.entry.scholar_amendments_lecte: Fixes a book taken off a lectern staying drawn on it (Scholar's lectern books) when Amendments is installed.
lifeguard.entry.sleep_tight_kill_stats.d: Fixes every kill you make counting twice in your mob statistics.
lifeguard.entry.sleep_tight_spawn_events: Fixes mobs that wake you up and bedbugs skipping the spawn checks every other mob goes through, so other mods' spawn rules and mob swaps never saw them.
lifeguard.entry.sexy_runic_glints.desc: Remake of most of the 17 (33 if DD is installed and dyeDepotRunes is on) enchantment glints with cool new looks, in a very distinctive new style. Switches back to plain Quark glints when a shaderpack is on to avoid rendering issues.
lifeguard.entry.cc_cannon_backfire.desc: Cannons can now backfire (causing a large explosion) any blocks in lifeguard:cannon_backfires, notably C&C's gunpowder.
lifeguard.entry.cc_golden_bucket_compat: Golden buckets in jars and cauldrons
Golden buckets pour a bucket into, or scoop a bucket out of, jars, Amendments' cauldrons and other Moonlight tanks, for any liquid, keeping the golden bucket and the buckets still in it (Moonlight treated them as plain buckets, losing them).

A filled golden bucket of a liquid Caverns & Chasms doesn't pour itself (like milk, or purple soda) pours into an empty cauldron as an Amendments cauldron, like a plain bucket of it, instead of being drunk or doing nothing.
lifeguard.entry.cc_golden_milk_follows_n: A golden milk bucket only fills a cauldron with Neapolitan's milk cauldron while Neapolitan's Milk Cauldron setting is on, like a regular milk bucket.
lifeguard.entry.supplementaries_grouper_: Fixes groupers between two chests, slabs, flowers or other blocks without a full side comparing entities instead of the blocks. Only air or liquid on both sides switches a grouper to comparing entities.
lifeguard.entry.faucet_pouring_recipes.d: Data-driven faucet pouring. A faucet pouring a fluid onto a block can turn it into another. By default, a few water pouring on dirtish blocks -> mud type recipes are enabled. Packs can add their own in data/<namespace>/faucet_pouring.
lifeguard.entry.faucet_pouring_recipes.e: Shows faucet pouring recipes, and Supplementaries' concrete powder hardening, as a category in EMI.
lifeguard.entry.no_supps_jar_fish.desc: Fish buckets no longer empty the fishes into jars, from players or dispensers. Not a bug, I'm just a fishy hater.
lifeguard.entry.supps_continuous_hand_ro: Makes pulling a rope up or letting it down by hand move what hangs from it the way a pulley does, using Supplementaries' new continuous_retraction (follows that config, so if its off this wont work). Can move slime contraptions similar to pistons, by hand with rope!
lifeguard.entry.supps_drinkables_sip_pac: A sip from a goblet or a placed jar takes as long as drinking the drink actually would, to avoid exploiting spamming goblet drinks for things like AC's purple soda.
lifeguard.entry.supps_captured_mob_jitte: Fixes mobs in jars and cages vibrating rapidly and not playing animations they're supposed to.
lifeguard.entry.themed_candle_holder_fla: Candle holders burn with the flame of what they're mounted on, like vanilla candles: soul flames on soul sand or soul soil, as Quark's Soul Candles does (and following its toggle).
Candles, candle cakes and candle holders resting on copper (any copper block, waxed or not, copper ore or raw copper) burn with Caverns & Chasms' cupric flames.
lifeguard.entry.supps_pedestal_compat.de: Items in lifeguard:pedestal_turned get a quarter turn on pedestals, so stuff with fancy models like Alex's Caves' raygun lies level instead of standing on its barrel.
lifeguard.entry.enderman_head_reach.desc: Enderman heads notice a player staring at them from further away (Supplementaries: 20 blocks).
lifeguard.entry.enderman_head_reach.valu: Range in blocks (64 is the most the look check reaches)
lifeguard.entry.supps_slice_maps_keep_th: Supplementaries slice maps keep the altimeter
The slice map recipe hands the altimeter back instead of using it up: the map turns into a slice map and the altimeter (Caverns & Chasms' depth gauge counts) stays in the crafting grid.
lifeguard.entry.supps_blue_bomb_dispensi: Fixes dispensers dropping blue bombs instead of throwing them. Loading one into a container in front still works.
lifeguard.entry.supps_soap_washes_labels: Supplementaries' soap washes the dye off a label.
Fixes comparators reading 3 extra from every cannon, so an empty cannon read 3 and any amount of gunpowder past 4 read the same.
lifeguard.entry.supps_faucet_cauldron_le: Faucets now fill water and powder snow cauldrons a third at a time, instead of a third and then the other two thirds at once.
lifeguard.entry.supps_faucet_honey.desc: Fixes bug where faucets can only pour honey into an empty beehive when the jar or cauldron behind them held exactly one bottle.
lifeguard.entry.supps_faucet_toggle.desc: Fixes a faucet sometimes needing two clicks to turn on or off: when the cauldron or tank behind it had changed without telling it, the first click was undone.
lifeguard.entry.supps_gunpowder_lights_n: Fixes burning gunpowder trails never lighting Alex's Caves' nuclear bomb.
lifeguard.entry.supps_lumisene_burn_time: Corrects burning lumisene and the Flammable effect setting you on fire for 8 ticks instead of 8 seconds.
lifeguard.entry.supps_moved_block_entiti: Fixes blocks moved by a Supplementaries rope not reacting to what's in them, like an Amendments cauldron of lava lowered onto a campfire boiling as if it held water.
lifeguard.entry.supps_moved_cauldron_fil: Fixes Supplementaries' moved cauldron filling, which broke completely for pulleys and had unpredictable results when pushing partially full cauldrons into fluid source blocks.
lifeguard.entry.supps_moving_block_conte: Fixes blocks moved by a piston or pulley being drawn without what's in them, like an amendments cauldron losing its liquid until it lands.
lifeguard.entry.supps_notice_board_compa: Fixes comparators reading 1 from any notice board holding something. A book reads 1 on its first page up to 15 on its last; anything else reads 15.
lifeguard.entry.supps_plunderer_raid_wea: Fixes Plunderers in later raid waves being handed a crossbow they can only club you with. They get an enchanted golden sword instead.
lifeguard.entry.supps_respects_mob_grief: Cannonballs fired by mobs, like Plunderers turning a cannon on you, break no blocks while the mobGriefing gamerule is off, like every other mob explosion. Still hurt though.
lifeguard.entry.whiter_labels.desc: Placed labels look more like plain white paper instead of Labels' default tan. You probably only want this if you're also making paper place labels.
lifeguard.entry.zeta_instance_race.desc: Fixes a rare race condition that can happen on launch where Quark drops out of Zeta's list of loaded mods.
